page.layout: One page of title text, centred; an engraved library stamp and an engraved ornament below the text; a handwritten "(1)" and a mark at the upper right (not printed text).

l.i: De singulis varia Sententia, ac Decreta,

page.notes: Library stamp (BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE VITTORIO EMANUELE III) and an ornamental crest/emblem with a crown are engravings, not transcribed. Handwritten "(1)" and a scribbled mark at upper right are not printed text. A dark smudge/banner at the top edge and a small watermark at the lower right corner are excluded. The line "Ex Typographia ADRIANI VLACQ." is set in small capitals; the "Q." end is as printed.
